title: Vertiv Names Jakki Haussler to Board of Directors
summary: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), today announced the appointment of Jakki Haussler to its Board of Directors. Ms. Haussler will serve on the Audit Committee of the Board.
body_markdown: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), today announced the appointment of Jakki Haussler to its Board of Directors. Ms. Haussler will serve on the Audit Committee of the Board.
